mission.zh: 美国首次尝试近距离探测金星，但运载火箭制导故障使任务在发射阶段结束
mission.en: Mariner 1 was the first U.S.

summary.zh: 美国首次尝试近距离探测金星，但运载火箭制导故障使任务在发射阶段结束。它展示了早期深空任务对可靠制导的依赖。
summary.en: Mariner 1 was the first U.S. attempt to launch a spacecraft to explore Venus up close. It was intended to perform a Venus flyby. The spacecraft was lost to a software glitch. Investigators found a typo had caused a fault in the launch vehicle's guidance software. The spacecraft and booster were destroyed shortly after launch for safety.

mission.zh: 首次成功飞掠另一颗行星的探测器
mission.en: NASA's Mariner 2 was humanity's first successful planetary science mission.

summary.zh: 首次成功飞掠另一颗行星的探测器。近距离测量揭示金星远比人们曾设想的更炎热，开启了用实测数据认识行星的时代。
summary.en: NASA's Mariner 2 was humanity's first successful planetary science mission. The first close-up look at another planet was full of surprises: Mariner 2 found Venus to be inhospitable, and far hotter than expected.

mission.en: NASA's Mariner 3 was designed to take photos of Mars after an eight-month journey studying interplanetary space.

summary.zh: 计划飞掠火星并拍照，但整流罩未正常分离，太阳能板无法展开，最终失去电力并留在日心轨道。
summary.en: NASA's Mariner 3 was designed to take photos of Mars after an eight-month journey studying interplanetary space. The spacecraft lost power and the inert spacecraft never reached the correct course for a Mars flyby.

name: MARINER 4

mission.zh: 首次成功近距离拍摄火星，传回布满撞击坑的地表影像；无线电掩星测量同时约束了稀薄大气，为后来的着陆器设计提供依据
mission.en: The Mariner 4 mission, the second of two Mars flyby attempts launched in 1964 by NASA, was one of the great early successes of the agency, and indeed the Space Age, returning the very first photos of another planet from deep space..

summary.zh: 首次成功近距离拍摄火星，传回布满撞击坑的地表影像；无线电掩星测量同时约束了稀薄大气，为后来的着陆器设计提供依据。
summary.en: The Mariner 4 mission, the second of two Mars flyby attempts launched in 1964 by NASA, was one of the great early successes of the agency, and indeed the Space Age, returning the very first photos of another planet from deep space.

vehicle: Atlas Agena D (Atlas Agena D no. 12 / Atlas D no. 288 / Agena D no. AD69/6932)

name: MARINER 5
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 由水手四号的备份平台改装，飞掠金星并测量其大气、磁场环境和太阳风相互作用
mission.en: Originally built as a backup to the successful Mariner 4 mission to Mars in 1965, Mariner 5 was modified to fly by Venus.

summary.zh: 由水手四号的备份平台改装，飞掠金星并测量其大气、磁场环境和太阳风相互作用。
summary.en: Originally built as a backup to the successful Mariner 4 mission to Mars in 1965, Mariner 5 was modified to fly by Venus. The spacecraft's flight path after its Venus encounter brought it closer to the Sun than any previous mission at the time.

vehicle: Atlas Agena D (Atlas Agena D no. 23 / Atlas D no. 5401 / Agena D no. AD157/6933)

name: MARINER 6
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 与水手七号组成双探测器任务，飞掠火星并拍摄地形和测量大气
mission.en: Mariner 6—along with its twin Mariner 7—was designed to make a close flyby of Mars to look for signs of life and to develop technology for future missions.

summary.zh: 与水手七号组成双探测器任务，飞掠火星并拍摄地形和测量大气。飞掠只能短暂观察，因此它的成果后来由轨道器长期观测补充。
summary.en: Mariner 6—along with its twin Mariner 7—was designed to make a close flyby of Mars to look for signs of life and to develop technology for future missions. It returned photos showing a chaotic and heavily cratered surface as well as the dark features long seen from Earth.

vehicle: Atlas Centaur (AC-20 / Atlas 3C no. 5403C / Centaur D-1A)

name: MARINER 7
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 在水手六号之后飞掠火星
mission.en: Mariner 7 made a close flyby of Mars just five days after its twin, Mariner 6.

summary.zh: 在水手六号之后飞掠火星。地面团队利用前一艘探测器的发现调整观测计划，增加对南极区域的成像。
summary.en: Mariner 7 made a close flyby of Mars just five days after its twin, Mariner 6. Scientists were able to instruct it to take additional pictures of the south pole, which had piqued their interest during Mariner 6's flyby.

vehicle: Atlas Centaur (AC-19 / Atlas 3C no. 5105C / Centaur D-1A)

orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.en: Mariner 8 was the first of two spacecraft designed to orbit Mars for at least 90 days and gather data on the Martian atmosphere and surface.

summary.zh: 原计划绕火星进行长期探测，但火箭故障导致航天器重返地球大气层，未进入火星轨道。
summary.en: Mariner 8 was the first of two spacecraft designed to orbit Mars for at least 90 days and gather data on the Martian atmosphere and surface. Mariner 8’s launch vehicle malfunctioned and the spacecraft reentered Earth’s atmosphere north of Puerto Rico.

vehicle: Atlas Centaur (AC-24 / Atlas 3C no. 5405C / Centaur D-1A)

name: MARINER 9
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 第一艘环绕另一颗行星运行的航天器
mission.en: NASA's Mariner 9 was the first spacecraft to orbit another planet, when it beat the Soviet Mars 2—which had an 11-day head start—to the Red Planet.

summary.zh: 第一艘环绕另一颗行星运行的航天器。在火星尘暴逐渐消退后绘制大范围地图，揭示巨型火山、峡谷和两颗卫星的细节。
summary.en: NASA's Mariner 9 was the first spacecraft to orbit another planet, when it beat the Soviet Mars 2—which had an 11-day head start—to the Red Planet. Mariner 9 mapped 85% of the Martian surface and sent back more than 7,000 pictures, including images of Olympus Mons, Valles Marineris, and the moons Phobos and Deimos.

vehicle: Atlas Centaur (AC-23 / Atlas 3C no. 5404C / Centaur D-1A)

mission.zh: 为后续探月任务测试航天器平台和空间环境仪器
mission.en: NASA’s Ranger 1 was a test mission for future Ranger spacecraft that would explore the Moon.

summary.zh: 为后续探月任务测试航天器平台和空间环境仪器。上面级故障使其滞留近地轨道，随后再入。
summary.en: NASA’s Ranger 1 was a test mission for future Ranger spacecraft that would explore the Moon. It also carried several experiments. The probe was supposed to enter a highly elliptical Earth orbit that would take it beyond the Moon. A rocket malfunction stranded it in low-Earth orbit and it reentered the atmosphere.

mission.en: Ranger 2 was NASA’s second spacecraft launched to enter a highly elliptical Earth orbit that would take it into beyond the Moon to test new technologies and conduct experiments.

summary.zh: 第二次远地点轨道技术试验，上面级故障使航天器未能进入预定轨道。结果推动了后续探月系统的改进。
summary.en: Ranger 2 was NASA’s second spacecraft launched to enter a highly elliptical Earth orbit that would take it into beyond the Moon to test new technologies and conduct experiments. Like its predecessor, a rocket malfunction stranded it in low-Earth orbit. It eventually lost power and reentered Earth’s atmosphere.

mission.en: Ranger 3 was NASA's first attempt to put a probe on the Moon.

summary.zh: 早期月球撞击探测尝试，故障使其错过月球并进入日心轨道；任务仍取得了行星际伽马射线测量。
summary.en: Ranger 3 was NASA's first attempt to put a probe on the Moon. It carried a TV camera and an instrument capsule. A series of malfunctions sent the spacecraft hurtling past the Moon, but it did take the first measurements of interplanetary gamma ray flux. Ranger 3 eventually entered heliocentric orbit.

mission.en: NASA's Ranger 4 was the first U.S.

summary.zh: 首个到达月球的美国航天器，但计算机故障使其未能开展预定观测，最终撞击月球背面。到达目标不等于完成科学任务。
summary.en: NASA's Ranger 4 was the first U.S. spacecraft to reach another celestial body—the Moon. It was designed to transmit pictures during descent and to rough-land a capsule carrying a seismometer and other instruments. A computer problem prevented it from performing any operations. It impacted the Moon’s far side.

summary.zh: 计划探测月球，但电力系统故障使电池耗尽，航天器未能完成预定任务。
summary.en: NASA's Ranger 5 was the third attempt by the United States to land a spacecraft on the Moon. A malfunction with the spacecraft's batteries caused them to drain after about eight hours of flight, leaving Ranger 5 inoperable.

mission.en: Ranger 6 was the closest to date to success in U.S.

summary.zh: 按计划撞击月球，但电视成像系统失效，未能传回近距离照片，为下一次任务暴露了关键工程问题。
summary.en: Ranger 6 was the closest to date to success in U.S. attempts to impact the Moon, but a short-circuit disabled the spacecraft before it could complete its mission. The probe did impact the Moon on target and on schedule, but its TV camera system was inoperable.

summary.en: Following on the success of NASA's Ranger 7 mission—the first U.S. spacecraft to photograph the Moon up close—Ranger 8 took more than 7,000 high-resolution images of the Moon.

summary.en: NASA's Ranger 9 was the last in a series of spacecraft launched in the 1960s to explore the Moon. It was designed to take images as it descended to the lunar surface for impact.

summary.en: NASA's Surveyor 2 was supposed to make a soft landing on the Moon, but a thruster failed to ignite, putting the spacecraft into a spin. The lander crashed on the Moon.

mission.en: NASA's Surveyor 3 was the second in the Surveyor series to make a soft landing on the Moon.

summary.zh: 在月面成功软着陆并测试土壤机械性质，为阿波罗登月舱提供承载能力证据；阿波罗十二号后来到访其着陆地点。
summary.en: NASA's Surveyor 3 was the second in the Surveyor series to make a soft landing on the Moon. Based on the spacecraft's surface sampling tests, scientists concluded the lunar surface was solid enough to hold the weight of an Apollo lunar module.

summary.en: NASA's Surveyor 4 was the fourth in a series of spacecraft designed to make a soft landing on the Moon. Radio signals from the spacecraft stopped a few minutes before touchdown and contact was never reestablished.

summary.en: NASA's Surveyor 5 lander was the first spacecraft to do a soil analysis on the Moon, or any other world. The mission nearly failed due to a leak in the spacecraft's thruster system, but engineers managed to land the spacecraft safely.

summary.en: NASA's Surveyor 6 was part of the highly successful series of landers sent to the Moon to study whether a future human mission was possible.

summary.en: Surveyor 7 was the last of the original series of Surveyor Moon landers of the late 1960s. It was the only spacecraft of the series to land in the lunar highland region and had the most extensive set of instruments.

summary.en: The Lunar Orbiter 1 spacecraft was designed primarily to photograph smooth areas of the lunar surface for selection and verification of safe landing sites for the Surveyor and Apollo missions.

mission.en: Like its predecessor, Lunar Orbiter 2 was designed primarily to collect images of the lunar surface, for safe landing sites for the Surveyor and Apollo missions.

summary.zh: 继续拍摄候选着陆地点，也取得哥白尼环形山的著名斜视图；辐射测量帮助评估载人飞行环境。
summary.en: Like its predecessor, Lunar Orbiter 2 was designed primarily to collect images of the lunar surface, for safe landing sites for the Surveyor and Apollo missions. These included a spectacular oblique picture of Copernicus crater which was dubbed by the news media as one of the great pictures of the century. Also, radiation experiments confirmed that the design of Apollo hardware would protect the astronauts from average and greater-than-average short term exposure to solar particle events.

summary.en: NASA’s Lunar Orbiter 3 was the final mission to photograph potential Apollo landing sites. A glitch prevented the spacecraft from relaying back all of its images, but it did meet all mission objectives. One of the images showed the Surveyor 2 lander on the lunar surface.

summary.en: NASA launched five successful Lunar Orbiter missions to the Moon from 1966 through 1967 to map the surface before the Apollo landings. All five missions were successful and 99% of the Moon was photographed. This mission and the one that followed were devoted to scientific objectives and were flown above the Moon's poles.

summary.en: NASA's Pioneer 5 provided the first map of the interplanetary magnetic field. This mission was part of the famous Pioneer program—which included far-ranging Pioneers 10 and 11—that charted the space between the planets.

mission.en: NASA's Pioneer 6 was the first in a series of spacecraft designed to obtain measurements of interplanetary phenomena from widely separated points in space..

summary.zh: 进入日心轨道连续测量行星际现象，以远离地球的位置补充地球附近的太阳活动观测。
summary.en: NASA's Pioneer 6 was the first in a series of spacecraft designed to obtain measurements of interplanetary phenomena from widely separated points in space.

orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 测量太阳风和磁场，并在1986年从远距离经过哈雷彗星附近，提供行星际环境背景数据
mission.en: Pioneer 7 was launched to a heliocentric orbit to study the Sun's magnetic fields and to measure characteristics of the solar wind.

summary.zh: 测量太阳风和磁场，并在1986年从远距离经过哈雷彗星附近，提供行星际环境背景数据。
summary.en: Pioneer 7 was launched to a heliocentric orbit to study the Sun's magnetic fields and to measure characteristics of the solar wind. On March 20, 1986, Pioneer 7 flew within 7.5 million miles (12.1 million kilometers) of Halley’s comet—the closest approach for a U.S. spacecraft.

vehicle: Thrust Augmented Improved Delta (Thor Delta E-1 no. 40 / Thor no. 462/DSV-3E)

name: PIONEER 8
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 长期在日心轨道研究行星际空间，回传数据持续近三十年，体现了简单可靠平台的长期科学价值
mission.en: NASA's Pioneer 8 was launched to heliocentric orbit to study interplanetary space.

summary.zh: 长期在日心轨道研究行星际空间，回传数据持续近三十年，体现了简单可靠平台的长期科学价值。
summary.en: NASA's Pioneer 8 was launched to heliocentric orbit to study interplanetary space. It sent back data for nearly 30 years.

vehicle: Thrust-Augmented Thor-Delta (Thor Delta E-1 no. 55 / Thor no. 489 / DSV-3E)

name: PIONEER 9
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 与同系列航天器组成分散于日心空间的测量网络，让科学家能够比较不同位置的太阳风条件
mission.en: NASA's Pioneer 9 was the fourth in a series of solar-orbiting spacecraft designed to measure interplanetary phenomena from widely separated points in space on a continuing basis..

summary.zh: 与同系列航天器组成分散于日心空间的测量网络，让科学家能够比较不同位置的太阳风条件。
summary.en: NASA's Pioneer 9 was the fourth in a series of solar-orbiting spacecraft designed to measure interplanetary phenomena from widely separated points in space on a continuing basis.

vehicle: Thrust-Augmented Improved ThorDelta (Thor Delta E-1 no. 60 / Thor no. 479 / DSV-3E)

name: VIKING 2
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 由轨道器与着陆器共同研究火星，结合全球背景、着陆点影像和原位实验
mission.en: Both NASA Viking missions used a combination of orbiter and lander to explore Mars in unprecedented detail..

summary.zh: 由轨道器与着陆器共同研究火星，结合全球背景、着陆点影像和原位实验。其生命探测实验的解释必须结合土壤化学环境。
summary.en: Both NASA Viking missions used a combination of orbiter and lander to explore Mars in unprecedented detail.

vehicle: Titan IIIE-Centaur (TC-3 / Titan no. E-3 / Centaur no. D-1T)

name: MARS PHOENIX
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 在火星北部高纬度软着陆，研究冰、土壤与大气
mission.en: Search for evidence of past or present microbial life.

summary.zh: 在火星北部高纬度软着陆，研究冰、土壤与大气。固定式平台以挖掘和原位分析探索浅表环境，补充巡视器的移动观测。
summary.en: Search for evidence of past or present microbial life

name: MESSENGER
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 首艘绕水星运行的航天器，长期测量地表成分、地质历史和磁场，并确认极区沉积物主要由水冰构成，最后撞击水星
mission.en: NASA's MESSENGER spacecraft orbited Mercury for more than four years.

summary.zh: 首艘绕水星运行的航天器，长期测量地表成分、地质历史和磁场，并确认极区沉积物主要由水冰构成，最后撞击水星。
summary.en: NASA's MESSENGER spacecraft orbited Mercury for more than four years. Among its accomplishments, the mission determined Mercury’s surface composition, revealed its geological history, discovered details about its internal magnetic field, and verified its polar deposits are dominantly water-ice. The mission ended when MESSENGER slammed into Mercury’s surface.

vehicle: Delta 7925H (no. D307)

name: DEEP SPACE 1
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 验证离子推进、自主导航等十二项技术，并顺访小天体
mission.en: NASA's Deep Space 1 was an engineering test flight for a dozen new technologies, including highly-efficient ion engines and autonomous navigation software.

summary.zh: 验证离子推进、自主导航等十二项技术，并顺访小天体。它把工程验证和科学飞掠结合，为后续深空任务降低技术风险。
summary.en: NASA's Deep Space 1 was an engineering test flight for a dozen new technologies, including highly-efficient ion engines and autonomous navigation software. Asteroid 9969 Braille was a bonus science target. DS1's primary mission was a resounding success. All 12 technology tests were successful.

name: GENESIS
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 采集太阳风样品并送回地球
mission.en: NASA's Genesis spacecraft spent more than two years collecting samples of the solar wind.

summary.zh: 采集太阳风样品并送回地球。返回舱硬着陆损坏了部分收集器，但样品仍被回收用于研究太阳物质组成。
summary.en: NASA's Genesis spacecraft spent more than two years collecting samples of the solar wind. The spacecraft then brought the sample canister back to Earth where it parachuted to the ground. Despite a hard landing in the Utah desert, the Genesis samples were recovered.

name: LCROSS
cn: 月球撞击坑观测与传感卫星
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 与上面级先后撞击月球南极永久阴影区域，观测溅射物以寻找水冰证据，是以撞击开展主动探测的案例
mission.en: NASA's Lunar Crater Observation and Sensing Satellite (LCROSS) was launched with the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter to determine if water-ice exists in a permanently shadowed crater at the Moon's south pole.

summary.zh: 与上面级先后撞击月球南极永久阴影区域，观测溅射物以寻找水冰证据，是以撞击开展主动探测的案例。
summary.en: NASA's Lunar Crater Observation and Sensing Satellite (LCROSS) was launched with the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter to determine if water-ice exists in a permanently shadowed crater at the Moon's south pole. As planned, LCROSS and its Centaur stage impacted the Moon on Oct. 9, 2009.

vehicle: Atlas V 401 (no. AV-020)

name: LADEE
cn: 月球大气与尘埃环境探测器
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.en: Study Earth’s Moon.

summary.zh: 从低月球轨道测量极稀薄外逸层和尘埃环境，研究无浓厚大气天体的近表面物质循环。
summary.en: Study Earth’s Moon

name: CLEMENTINE
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 在月球轨道测试航天器技术并开展多波段测绘
mission.en: Clementine was the first U.S.

summary.zh: 在月球轨道测试航天器技术并开展多波段测绘。月球任务成功，但后续小行星飞掠因故障取消。
summary.en: Clementine was the first U.S. spacecraft launched to the Moon in over 20 years. It was designed to test spacecraft components during extended exposure to space and to study the Moon and an asteroid. The mission succeeded in its lunar objectives, but a malfunction forced the asteroid flyby to be canceled.

vehicle: Titan 2G (no. 23G-11)

name: LUNAR PROSPECTOR
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 测量月球表面成分、重力和磁场，寻找极区富氢物质；这些信号为水冰研究提供线索，但须结合后续任务判读
mission.en: NASA's Lunar Prospector orbited the Moon for almost 19 months to map its surface composition and to look for polar ice.

summary.zh: 测量月球表面成分、重力和磁场，寻找极区富氢物质；这些信号为水冰研究提供线索，但须结合后续任务判读。
summary.en: NASA's Lunar Prospector orbited the Moon for almost 19 months to map its surface composition and to look for polar ice. The probe found evidence suggesting water ice at both poles. The mission ended with the spacecraft impacting the lunar surface, creating a dust cloud that was studied from Earth.

vehicle: Athena-2 (LM-004)

name: SEASAT
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 以雷达等遥感仪器研究海洋，推动从太空测量海面形态、海风和海洋动力学，是后来海洋观测卫星的重要技术先导
mission.en: Test oceanographic sensors and monitor Earth's seas.

summary.zh: 以雷达等遥感仪器研究海洋，推动从太空测量海面形态、海风和海洋动力学，是后来海洋观测卫星的重要技术先导。
summary.en: Test oceanographic sensors and monitor Earth's seas

name: SORCE

mission.en: Measure incoming X-ray, ultraviolet, visible, near-infrared, and total solar radiation.

summary.zh: 测量太阳总辐照度与光谱辐照度，帮助区分太阳输入变化和地球气候系统响应。
summary.en: Measure incoming X-ray, ultraviolet, visible, near-infrared, and total solar radiation

mission.en: Measure monthly and seasonal rainfall over the global tropics and subtropics.

summary.zh: 美国与日本联合研究热带、亚热带降雨的任务，用空间观测补足海洋和偏远地区的雨量资料。
summary.en: Measure monthly and seasonal rainfall over the global tropics and subtropics

mission.en: Study Earth's upper atmosphere.

summary.zh: 研究高层大气成分与能量过程，帮助理解臭氧、化学反应和大气动力学之间的联系。
summary.en: Study Earth's upper atmosphere

mission.en: Explore the basic physics of particle acceleration and energy release in solar flares.

summary.zh: 通过高能辐射研究太阳耀斑中的粒子加速和能量释放，使光学影像之外的高能过程能够被测量。
summary.en: Explore the basic physics of particle acceleration and energy release in solar flares

mission.en: Examine the three-dimensional magnetic structures that emerge through the Sun's photosphere.

summary.zh: 对太阳过渡区和日冕成像，观察细小磁结构与高温等离子体之间的联系，帮助研究太阳大气加热。
summary.en: Examine the three-dimensional magnetic structures that emerge through the Sun's photosphere

name: SAMPEX

mission.en: Study charged particles affecting Earth's magnetic environment.

summary.zh: 测量高能带电粒子，研究太阳、宇宙射线和地球磁层中的粒子如何进入并影响近地环境。
summary.en: Study charged particles affecting Earth's magnetic environment

name: FAST
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.en: Investigate the behavior of plasma and particles during auroras.

summary.zh: 穿越极光相关区域，测量等离子体与粒子过程，用局部高时间分辨率观测解释极光形成机制。
summary.en: Investigate the behavior of plasma and particles during auroras

orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.en: Studied the response of Earth’s global magnetic environment.

summary.zh: 将局部粒子测量扩展为磁层整体成像，追踪地球磁环境如何响应太阳风变化。
summary.en: Studied the response of Earth’s global magnetic environment

name: TIMED

mission.zh: 研究中间层与低热层、电离层的能量和动力学，观测连接地球大气与太空的过渡区域
mission.en: Study a little-examined region of Earth's atmosphere.

summary.zh: 研究中间层与低热层、电离层的能量和动力学，观测连接地球大气与太空的过渡区域。
summary.en: Study a little-examined region of Earth's atmosphere

name: AIM

mission.en: Study night-shining clouds.

summary.zh: 研究夜光云的形成和变化，利用高层大气中的冰晶云追踪温度、水汽与环境条件。
summary.en: Study night-shining clouds

name: IBEX
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 通过能量中性原子观测描绘日球层边界的远程图景，探测器本身并不需要飞到太阳系边界
mission.en: Map the boundary of the solar system.

summary.zh: 通过能量中性原子观测描绘日球层边界的远程图景，探测器本身并不需要飞到太阳系边界。
summary.en: Map the boundary of the solar system

vehicle: Pegasus XL Rocket

orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 从日地系统附近的远距离观测位置监测太阳风并观测地球，用于空间天气预警和整盘地球研究
mission.en: Real-time solar wind observations to provide early warnings about geomagnetic storms.

summary.zh: 从日地系统附近的远距离观测位置监测太阳风并观测地球，用于空间天气预警和整盘地球研究。
summary.en: Real-time solar wind observations to provide early warnings about geomagnetic storms

vehicle: Falcon 9 v1.1

name: NUSTAR
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 聚焦高能X射线，研究黑洞、中子星和超新星遗迹
mission.en: Map Selected Regions of the Sky.

summary.zh: 聚焦高能X射线，研究黑洞、中子星和超新星遗迹。不同波段揭示的物理过程与可见光照片并不相同。
summary.en: Map Selected Regions of the Sky

name: GALEX
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 以紫外巡天研究星系中的恒星形成与演化，帮助识别年轻恒星和正在发生恒星形成的区域
mission.en: Measure the history of star formation by observing the universe in ultraviolet wavelengths.

summary.zh: 以紫外巡天研究星系中的恒星形成与演化，帮助识别年轻恒星和正在发生恒星形成的区域。
summary.en: Measure the history of star formation by observing the universe in ultraviolet wavelengths

name: FUSE
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 通过远紫外光谱研究恒星和星际介质中的气体，不只拍摄外观，而是利用谱线分析物质成分与运动
mission.en: NASA’s FUSE (Far Ultraviolet Spectroscopic Explorer) mission observed the sky in far-ultraviolet light — wavelengths between about 90 to 120 nanometers — with greater sensitivity and resolving power than previous instruments.

summary.zh: 通过远紫外光谱研究恒星和星际介质中的气体，不只拍摄外观，而是利用谱线分析物质成分与运动。
summary.en: NASA’s FUSE (Far Ultraviolet Spectroscopic Explorer) mission observed the sky in far-ultraviolet light — wavelengths between about 90 to 120 nanometers — with greater sensitivity and resolving power than previous instruments. Over eight years of operations, FUSE acquired more than 6,000 observations of nearly 3,000 separate astronomical targets, including massive stars, supernova remnants, and galaxies.

name: SUZAKU
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 日本主导、美国参与的X射线任务，研究超新星、黑洞及高温宇宙中的元素和能量过程
mission.en: Suzaku was a space satellite that studied sources of high-energy X-rays like supernova explosions and black holes.

summary.zh: 日本主导、美国参与的X射线任务，研究超新星、黑洞及高温宇宙中的元素和能量过程。
summary.en: Suzaku was a space satellite that studied sources of high-energy X-rays like supernova explosions and black holes. The Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency led the mission, which was developed in collaboration with Japanese and U.S. institutions, including NASA.

name: HITOMI
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 日本与国际伙伴合作的高能天文台
mission.en: NASA partnered with the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency on Hitomi, an X-ray observatory designed to detect radiation ranging from X-rays to gamma rays.

summary.zh: 日本与国际伙伴合作的高能天文台。任务寿命很短，但获得的数据仍用于研究星系团高温气体与元素。
summary.en: NASA partnered with the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency on Hitomi, an X-ray observatory designed to detect radiation ranging from X-rays to gamma rays. Hitomi’s goal was to study cosmic elements from the evolution of the universe to the distribution of dark matter within galaxy clusters.

name: RXTE
orbitCn: 任务位置示意 · 非实时轨道

mission.zh: 研究黑洞、中子星和白矮星附近随时间快速变化的X射线，利用亮度变化理解极端环境的物理过程
mission.en: NASA’s RXTE (Rossi X-ray Timing Explorer) satellite collected information about the extreme environments that surround black holes, neutron stars, white dwarfs, and other cosmic objects that emit X-rays..

summary.zh: 研究黑洞、中子星和白矮星附近随时间快速变化的X射线，利用亮度变化理解极端环境的物理过程。
summary.en: NASA’s RXTE (Rossi X-ray Timing Explorer) satellite collected information about the extreme environments that surround black holes, neutron stars, white dwarfs, and other cosmic objects that emit X-rays.
